# Overall objectives of this track

- understand challenges related to large array data and key strategies to address them
- gain hands-on Python experience and increase confidence in handling large array data
- appreciate the diversity of the open-source Python ecosystem for large array data and how you are part of it

## Overview

- day 1: theory, motivation, intro to zarr and dask
- day 2: parallelisation with dask, standards for large imaging data
- day 3: advanced topics: compression, benchmarking, visualisation, real-life applications
- day 4-5: collaboration

## `numpy` is great!

`numpy` is the default scientific Python library to process array data.
It works well for many applications.
Using `numpy` keeps your code simple, more accessible, and easy-to-read.
